dek: The Census and Statistics Department (C&SD) released today (August 11) the results of the Monthly Survey on Business Situation of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) for July 2026. The current diffusion index (DI) on business receipts amongst SMEs decreased from 44.0 in June 2026 in the contractionary zone to 43.
